title: EnsembleConfiguration
description: Groups a set of EnsembleElements that together constitute a certified liquid and/or particulate contaminant-protection configuration. NFPA 1851 4.3.4 requires organizations to document which specific elements and interface components make up such a configuration (e.g., a particulate hood is only rated as part of a specific coat/pant/interface combination) — this is a relationship record, not a property of any single element.

protection_type.description: NFPA 1851 4.3.4: type of optional contaminant protection this configuration provides.

member_element_ids.description: FKs to EnsembleElement.element_id — every element and interface component required for this configuration to provide its certified protection (e.g., coat, pant, hood, interface gaskets/closures).

certification_ref.description: The specific certification this configuration (as a set) is rated to, if distinct from individual element certifications.

notes.description: E.g., substitution constraints — whether member elements can be swapped for other certified equivalents without invalidating the configuration.
